title: Idolatry in the Temple

questions.question: Who was sitting before Ezekiel in his house when the hand of the Lord God fell upon him?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:1 (ESV): "In the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, with the elders of Judah sitting before me, the hand of the Lord God fell upon me there."

questions.question: What did the figure with the appearance of a man (or fire) do to transport Ezekiel?
options: He put out the form of a hand and took him by a lock of his head, and the Spirit lifted him up between earth and heaven
He told Ezekiel to close his eyes and he awoke in Jerusalem
He carried Ezekiel on the wings of an eagle
He struck the ground and a tunnel appeared
questions.correctAnswer: He put out the form of a hand and took him by a lock of his head, and the Spirit lifted him up between earth and heaven
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:3 (ESV): "He put out the form of a hand and took me by a lock of my head, and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and brought me in visions of God to Jerusalem,"

questions.question: Where in Jerusalem was Ezekiel brought first in the vision?
options: To the entrance of the gateway of the inner court that faces north
To the altar of burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: To the entrance of the gateway of the inner court that faces north
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:3 (ESV): "brought me in visions of God to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the gateway of the inner court that faces north,"

questions.question: What was sitting at the entrance of the gateway of the inner court that faces north?
options: The seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy
questions.correctAnswer: The seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:3 (ESV): "where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy."

questions.question: God tells Ezekiel to look toward the north. He sees the image of jealousy, and God says, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing, the great abominations that the house of Israel are committing here, to... ?"
options: Drive me far from my sanctuary
Make me angry and destroy them
questions.correctAnswer: Drive me far from my sanctuary
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:6 (ESV): "the great abominations that the house of Israel are committing here, to drive me far from my sanctuary? But you will see still greater abominations."

questions.question: When Ezekiel was brought to the entrance of the court, what did he see in the wall?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:7 (ESV): "And he brought me to the entrance of the court, and when I looked, behold, there was a hole in the wall."

questions.question: What did God tell Ezekiel to do to the wall with the hole in it?
options: Break it down with a hammer
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:8 (ESV): "Then he said to me, 'Son of man, dig through the wall.' And when I had dug through the wall, behold, there was an entrance."

questions.question: When Ezekiel went in and looked, what was portrayed on the wall all around?
options: All kinds of creeping things, and loathsome beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel
Images of the gods of Egypt standing in chariots
questions.correctAnswer: All kinds of creeping things, and loathsome beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:10 (ESV): "So I went in and saw. And there, engraved on the wall all around, was every form of creeping things and loathsome beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel."

questions.question: Who was standing before these idols, offering a thick cloud of incense?
options: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel
The high priest and his sons
questions.correctAnswer: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:11 (ESV): "And before them stood seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel..."

questions.question: Which specific elder, son of Shaphan, is mentioned as standing among them?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:11 (ESV): "with Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan standing among them."

questions.question: Why did the elders say they were doing this in the dark in their rooms of pictures?
options: "The Lord does not see us, the Lord has forsaken the land."
"We must keep our worship secret from the Babylonians."
questions.correctAnswer: "The Lord does not see us, the Lord has forsaken the land."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:12 (ESV): "for they say, 'The Lord does not see us, the Lord has forsaken the land.'"

questions.question: When Ezekiel was brought to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the Lord, what did he see women doing?
options: Baking cakes for the Queen of Heaven
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:14 (ESV): "and behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz."

questions.question: Finally, Ezekiel is brought into the inner court. Between the porch and the altar, what were about twenty-five men doing?
options: With their backs to the temple, they were bowing down to the sun toward the east
They were sacrificing a pig on the altar
They were consulting mediums and necromancers
They were burying the law of Moses
questions.correctAnswer: With their backs to the temple, they were bowing down to the sun toward the east
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:16 (ESV): "with their backs to the temple of the Lord, and their faces toward the east, worshiping the sun toward the east."

questions.question: God says, "Is it too light a thing for the house of Judah to commit the abominations that they commit here, that they should fill the land with violence and provoke me still further to anger? Behold, they put... to their nose."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:17 (ESV): "Behold, they put the branch to their nose." (A gesture associated with pagan worship).

questions.question: Because of these abominations, what is God's concluding promise in chapter 8?
options: "Therefore I will act in wrath. My eye will not spare, nor will I have pity. And though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, I will not hear them."
"I will send fire on the city immediately, and no one will survive."
"I will forgive them one last time because of my name."
"I will let Babylon rule over them forever in peace."
questions.correctAnswer: "Therefore I will act in wrath. My eye will not spare, nor will I have pity. And though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, I will not hear them."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:18 (ESV): "Therefore I will act in wrath. My eye will not spare, nor will I have pity. And though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, I will not hear them."

key_verse_text: Then he said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark, each in his room of pictures? For they say, 'The Lord does not see us, the Lord has forsaken the land.'"
